A '''Zallakesh prison ship''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|spaceship]] connected with the spaceport of [[Zallakesh]] on [[Chuzalla]].

==History==
Zallakesh had a history of dealing with slavers and the [[Protocol droid/Legends|Protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] warned his companions of the dangers of getting caught by them right before their passenger ship landed on Chuzalla.
